stories.headline: Pakistan emerges as key mediator in US-Iran war with Asim Munir leading diplomatic efforts
stories.summary: Pakistan has positioned itself as a crucial intermediary in the US-Iran conflict, with Army Chief Field Marshal Asim Munir taking a central diplomatic role. Trump has called Munir his 'favorite field marshal' and Pakistan has offered to host peace talks in Islamabad.

articles.title: From international outcast to mediator in Iran war, Pakistan's remarkable makeover

stories.headline: Pakistan faces severe fuel price crisis as PM Shehbaz announces relief measures amid regional tensions
stories.summary: Pakistan experienced unprecedented fuel price increases with petrol reaching PKR 458 per liter, sparking widespread protests. PM Shehbaz Sharif announced an Rs80 price cut and relief packages including free public transport and subsidies for motorcyclists.

articles.title: Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif Reduces Petrol Prices, Announces Free Public Transport Amid Energy Crisis, Iran War

stories.headline: Imran Khan seeks urgent court access to lawyers, challenges sentences in corruption cases
stories.summary: Former PM Imran Khan filed applications with Islamabad High Court seeking immediate access to his legal team after claiming no meaningful meetings since December 2025. He is challenging sentences in the £190 million corruption case and Toshakhana cases.

articles.title: Counsel seeks IHC order for meeting Imran

stories.headline: Pakistan security forces kill 21 militants in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa operations
stories.summary: Pakistani security forces conducted multiple intelligence-based operations in KP, killing 21 India-backed militants according to ISPR. Operations took place in Bara, Bannu, and North Waziristan districts along the Pakistan-Afghanistan border.

stories.summary: President Zardari and PM Shehbaz Sharif extended warm Easter greetings to Pakistan's Christian community, highlighting their contributions to national development and reaffirming the government's commitment to protecting minority rights.

stories.headline: UAE expresses displeasure over Pakistan's Iran tilt, threatens $2 billion support withdrawal
stories.summary: UAE leadership questioned Pakistan's stance on Iran conflict, particularly its engagement with Tehran while Emirates faced direct fallout. Army Chief Asim Munir conveyed UAE concerns to PM Shehbaz, with reports suggesting $2 billion financial support could be at risk.

stories.headline: Pakistan marks 47th death anniversary of PPP founder Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
stories.summary: Pakistan observed the 47th death anniversary of former PM and PPP founder Zulfikar Ali Bhutto. President Zardari, Bilawal Bhutto, and other leaders paid tributes, emphasizing his role in drafting the 1973 Constitution and democratic legacy.

articles.title: 47th death anniversary of Shaheed ZAB observed with devotion

stories.headline: Pakistan Navy inducts second MILGEM corvette PNS Khaibar, concludes Sea Guardian exercise with China
stories.summary: Pakistan Navy inducted its second MILGEM-class corvette PNS Khaibar and concluded the seven-day Sea Guardian IV exercise with Chinese PLA Navy. President Zardari praised the navy's growing capabilities amid regional security challenges.

articles.title: Pakistan Navy inducts 2nd Milgem Class Corvette into fleet

stories.headline: Bilawal Bhutto condemns Iran war, calls for political unity amid economic challenges
stories.summary: PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari condemned the 'illegal' US-Israeli war on Iran, warning of global spillover effects. He called for political unity and announced PPP support for mini-budget measures to address economic challenges caused by the regional conflict.

articles.title: Will back govton mini-budget, says Bilawal

stories.headline: Pakistan's Deputy PM Ishaq Dar sustains fracture during diplomatic reception
stories.summary: Foreign Minister and Deputy PM Ishaq Dar suffered a hairline shoulder fracture after falling during a reception for his Egyptian counterpart. Despite the injury, he continued his diplomatic engagements throughout the day.

articles.title: Pakistan Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar sustains 'hairline fracture' after fall during Egypt Foreign Minister's reception

articles.title: 5 Arrested For Blast Outside BJP Headquarters In Chandigarh, ISI Link Emerges
